what: The ten stops shot on the weekend of 11/6 to 11/8, taken off the run sheet (public/verizon.html). Two of them, Lawrence TCC 74630 and Newton Victra 118416, stay visible in the Plan tab's 'Open follow-up' card because both still need work.
how_it_works: The ids are in the RETIRED table in public/verizon.html. The rows stay in DATA; the page leaves retired ids out of J, so they are off every list, count, map and plan day. Plan days that named them keep the ids in d.retired.
to_reverse: Delete the stop's line from RETIRED in public/verizon.html. It comes back to every list, count and map; the ids on a plan day's d.retired list can be put back into d.ids. If DATA is ever regenerated without these rows, re-insert the 'row' objects below.
not_touched: The IDS Master Sheet: no row was edited or deleted. Their Completed-tab status is handled separately.

counts.left_to_shoot_basis: The app's own Left to shoot counter (Score tab) on a fresh device, which counts a stop as shot when its lock or the book says so: 47 before the removal, 39 after. This file first said 68 and 60; those were counted by book status alone and were wrong. Corrected 11/10. The eight-stop drop was right.
